verdict.rationale: Bitwarden ships an official, fully-featured CLI, and a personal API key for CLI authentication that the docs describe as suitable for automated workflows. The CLI also offers a documented `bw serve` local REST API, and a runtime probe confirmed it installs keylessly from npm. Together these support headless, non-interactive use. Missing for 10: CI-specific documentation (e.g. pipeline/GitHub Actions integration or non-interactive vault-unlock guidance) and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Using the personal API key for CLI authentication is suitable for automated workflows
The Bitwarden command-line interface (CLI) is a powerful, fully-featured tool for accessing and managing your vault.
the official bw CLI installs keylessly from npm (@bitwarden/cli, registry latest 2026.8.0) and prints its version
